## Description

Each dental chair is a resource with its own hours. A dental procedure carries a default duration (for example root canal 60 min, scaling 30 min) that sets the appointment length. An appointment holds a dentist and a chair.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A booking reserves both the dentist and the chair; neither can be double-booked (same guard as P1-022, tested under concurrency).
- [ ] **AC2.** Choosing a procedure sets the slot length; reception can lengthen it.
- [ ] **AC3.** The day view can be shown by chair as well as by dentist, in English and Arabic.

## Notes / open questions

- Source: DentalERP (github.com/abinauv/dental-erp, MIT; reference reviewed 17 Nov 2026).
- Pick up from DentalERP: `chairNumber` on Appointment and `defaultDuration` on Procedure (prisma/schema.prisma) show the idea only; chairs there are a number, not a resource with hours.
- Data to take: the duration of each procedure from prisma/seed-data/IN/procedures.ts (feeds P8-010).
